newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Western nickel mine output up in February -INSG.
newsitem.headline: Western nickel mine output up in February -INSG.

text.p: Western world nickel mine production rose in February to 57,600 tonnes from 53,500 in January, when output was hit by a sharp fall in New Caledonia's figures, the International Nickel Study Group said.
New Caledonian production returned to a more normal 10,000 tonnes in February after slipping to 5,300 tonnes in January, when seasonal factors depressed the figure, the INSG said.
Other mine production figures renmained steady, with Canada the world's largest, holding unchanged at 16,700 tonnes.
Western world production of primary nickel was steady at 58,100 tonnes only 200 below January's total.
Canadian output rose 600 tonnes to 11,200 but Australia's was down 700 at 5,200 tonnes. Other countries' totals were little changed on January.

On the consumption side, offtake in the west was little changed at 75,600 tonnes. A small slip was recorded in Japanese offtake, down 600 tonnes to 16,600, but Sweden registered a jump of 800 tonnes to 2,400.
